title: How Much Do I Expect to Make If I Publish My First Book?

description: How Much Do I Expect to Make If I Publish My First Book. Learn about book royalties, Amazon KDP, self-publishing income, and earning potential

blocks.text: One of the first questions aspiring authors ask is:
How Much Can I Earn From My First Published Book?

The honest answer is that there isn’t a one-size-fits-all figure. Your earnings depend on your publishing method, book price, royalty rate, marketing efforts, genre, and the number of copies you sell.

While some first-time authors earn only a few hundred dollars, others generate thousands, or even build a full-time income over time. The key is understanding how publishing royalties work and setting realistic expectations.
This guide explains exactly how authors make money, what you can realistically expect from your first book, and how to maximize your earnings.
Quick Answer

If you’re publishing your first book, earning between a few hundred dollars and several thousand dollars is a realistic expectation. Some books sell fewer than 100 copies, while others sell thousands through effective marketing and strong reader demand.
Authors who self-publish generally earn higher royalties than those who publish traditionally because they retain more control over pricing and distribution.
How Do Authors Make Money?
Authors primarily earn money through book royalties. Every time someone purchases your book, you receive a percentage of the selling price.
Your income depends on:
Self-Publishing vs. Traditional Publishing
Self-Publishing
Platforms like **Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP)** and IngramSpark allow authors to publish independently while keeping significantly higher royalty percentages.
Benefits include:
Amazon KDP offers **up to 70% royalties on eligible eBooks** and **up to 60% royalties on print books**, with print royalties reduced by production costs.
Traditional Publishing

Traditional publishers usually pay an advance against future royalties. According to Reedsy, many debut authors receive advances ranging from **$1,000 to $10,000**, with royalty payments beginning only after the advance has been earned back through book sales.
Traditional publishing may offer professional editorial support and bookstore distribution, but royalty rates are generally much lower than self-publishing.
How Much Does Amazon KDP Pay?
Amazon KDP provides two royalty options for eBooks:

items: Up to **[70% royalties](https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G200634560)** for eligible books priced within qualifying ranges.
**35% royalties** for books outside those pricing requirements.

blocks.text: For print books sold through Amazon, authors can earn **up to 60% royalties**, minus printing costs.
Example Royalty Earnings
Suppose you publish a paperback priced at **$14.99**.
Depending on your page count and printing costs, your royalty could be approximately **$4 per copy**.
These figures are estimates only. Your actual earnings will vary based on printing costs, wholesale discounts, and distribution channels.

Book Pricing
Pricing too high can reduce sales, while pricing too low may reduce profits.
Marketing

Can You Make a Living Writing Books?
Yes, but it rarely happens with a single book.

Most full-time independent authors build income by publishing multiple books, growing their audience, and creating a recognizable author brand over time. Each new release helps generate additional sales across their existing catalog.
How to Increase Your Book Earnings
If you want your first book to generate more income, consider these strategies:

items: Publish in paperback, hardcover, eBook, and audiobook formats.
Optimize your Amazon listing with relevant keywords and categories.

Continue publishing to expand your catalog and increase long-term royalties.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions
How much money does a first-time author usually make?
Most first-time authors earn anywhere from a few hundred dollars to several thousand dollars, depending on book sales, pricing, and marketing efforts.
Is self-publishing more profitable?
For many authors, yes. Self-publishing offers higher royalty percentages and complete control over pricing, rights, and marketing, although authors are responsible for production and promotion.
How much royalty does Amazon KDP pay?
Amazon KDP offers up to **70% royalties on eligible eBooks** and up to **60% royalties on print books**, less printing costs.
How many books do I need to sell to make $10,000?
If your average royalty is $4 per book, you would need to sell approximately **2,500 copies** to earn around **$10,000** before taxes and marketing expenses.
Can my first book become a bestseller?

Yes, but it requires a combination of a high-quality book, strategic marketing, reader engagement, and ongoing promotion. While bestseller success is possible, most authors build momentum across multiple releases.
